headings.usage: Verse display, full-verse translation, major section titles.

mono.usage: Grammar tags, IPA phonetic text, Sandhi splits.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use ambient glows rather than hard drop shadows. Example: shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(226,123,88,0.15)] for the currently playing word.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 on word cards. Use a subtle gradient border for the ElevenLabs config panel to signify technology integration.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate the provided weathered paper image with mix-blend-overlay at 4-5% opacity across the background to eliminate the 'flat digital' feel and evoke ancient manuscripts.

layouts.main_container: Max-width 5xl, generously padded (p-6 md:p-12 lg:p-16), left or naturally aligned.
layouts.input_section: Textarea should feel expansive, like writing on a scholarly slate. Internal padding of p-6 or p-8.
layouts.analysis_grid: High-Density 'Bento' Grid for word cards: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Let the cards flow naturally.
layouts.verse_display: Massive text for the original verse (text-3xl to text-5xl). Left-aligned. Use leading-loose to accommodate complex Devanagari diacritics.

components.word_card: Flat Solid Surface. bg-[#121215] with 1px border-[#27272A]. Internal padding p-6. Top: Sanskrit word (Serif text-xl), Middle: Meaning (Sans text-base text-text_muted), Bottom: Grammar Tags.
components.grammar_tag: Small pill shape, text-[11px] font-mono tracking-wider uppercase, bg-white/5 border border-white/10.
components.play_button: Pill-shaped, bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary_hover. Include a subtle scale-up animation on hover.
components.settings_panel: Crystal Glass variant. backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60, border-white/10. Used for the ElevenLabs API Key and Voice ID inputs.
components.confidence_badge: Subtle top-border accent on the word card or a small dot indicator. Use #F59E0B (Amber) for low confidence.

motion.word_cards: Staggered fade-up using framer-motion. delay: index * 0.05.
motion.hover_states: Interactive cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and their border brightens to border-white/30.
motion.audio_playback: When audio is playing, highlight the currently spoken word card with a primary colored border or subtle background tint.

images.description: Weathered beige grunge paper. Use as a fixed background texture (opacity 5%, mix-blend-overlay, z-[-1]) behind the main app container.
images.implementation: fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none object-cover w-full h-full

images.description: Calm water abstract. Use as a masked header background or prominently in the 'Analysis unavailable' error state.
images.implementation: mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, black, transparent); max-h-[40vh] object-cover

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all grammar tags and primary colors meet APCA/WCAG 3:1 minimums against the #121215 background. Check terracotta against dark gray.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the staggered card entrances.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: 'Cormorant Garamond' (weights 300, 400, 500), 'Manrope' (weights 400, 500, 600), and 'JetBrains Mono'.
Use framer-motion for staggering the word-by-word analysis cards on load.
Configure the ElevenLabs API key input inside a Shadcn Dialog. Keep this stateless (save to localStorage or memory).
Ensure the Textarea for verse input has a generous minimum height, allows vertical scrolling, and has a character counter (cap at 500).
Use 'sonner' for TTS fallback warnings or 'API key missing' notifications.
DO NOT apply generic global transitions. Be deliberate with motion.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='analyze-btn', data-testid='play-audio-btn', data-testid='elevenlabs-settings').
Handle the 'Analysis unavailable' state gracefully, utilizing the meditative hero image to maintain visual quality even on failure.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use optical alignment.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers or floating panels.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
DO NOT center align the app container in App.css (.App { text-align: center; } MUST be removed).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react, do not use raw SVGs unless strictly necessary.
